text.text: We sprung for the “exquisite” set menu at this notable spot and were very pleased with the results. After some cute amuse-style appetizers (one of which was referenced later in the meal), the meal slams on the accelerator for the next three dishes. The Buddha Jumping Over The Wall is nuanced and rich, the lobster ball is sweet and spicy, and the Wagyu beef cheek is peerless, tender enough for a butter knife with thick veins of connective tissue that are a true delight on the palate. This is the set’s high point, not that the successive dishes aren’t great as well. A fun and delicious offering that is worth the expense.

text.text: This restaurant, featured in the MICHELIN Guide, offers a wonderful blend of traditional and modern Chinese cuisine. The head chef skillfully incorporates local, fresh ingredients with creative flair. Guests can expect top-notch service and breathtaking views, resulting in an extraordinary dining experience.
